item.title: .NET Threads: The Performance Trap Hiding in Your Code
item.description: Creating background tasks in .NET applications is crucial to maintain responsiveness. While dedicated threads can be used, they incur significant overhead. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/08/09/net-threads-the-performance-trap-hiding-in-your-code/

item.title: P/Invoke Showdown: [DllImport] vs. [LibraryImport] in Modern .NET
item.description: Is [LibraryImport] always faster than [DllImport]? Not necessarily. I benchmarked both across native Windows API calls, string marshalling, handles, out parameters, and allocation-heavy scenarios. The results may surprise you. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/08/02/p-invoke-showdown-dllimport-vs-libraryimport-in-modern-net/
